summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Korea Electric Power Corp. (KEPCO) reporting the results of an extraordinary general meeting held on May 21, 2026. The sole agenda item was the election of a standing director as Comptroller Auditor General and member of the Audit Committee. The filing contains no transactional elements, no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any special-situation event. It is a standard corporate governance update required by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16. No special-situation classification applies.
